blocks.text: Leth, Mael, Soren, and Vey — the Warm Copy network

Origin / identity. Leth is restored through the House of Returning; Mael is the technician and narrator; Soren is Leth’s chosen partner; Vey is another restoration who remembers information that should not have crossed the recorded transfer.

Importance. Their impossible memories create the Warm Copy problem: dormant archives may have remained active, and a lawful restoration may carry lived influence that provenance systems cannot explain.

Final status. The House proves no single cause. Mael preserves the evidence and teaches later technicians to ask who lived in an impossible memory before asking how to delete it. Later individual fates remain unrecorded.
